title: Toolbar — Home, New Project, Text Tool, Theme Toggle
description: Create the Toolbar component with: Home button (navigates to home/welcome screen), New Project button (resets ProjectStore), Text Tool button (creates a new text layer), and Theme toggle button (toggles light/dark via ThemeStore). Toolbar is a horizontal bar at the top or side of the editor layout.
acceptance_criteria: Home button sets UIStore to home/welcome screen view
New Project button resets ProjectStore to fresh state
Text Tool button creates a new TextLayer in ProjectStore
Theme toggle button toggles ThemeStore (light/dark) with visual icon change
All buttons use IconButton from ui-library
Tooltip on hover for each button
completion_summary: Toolbar with Home, New Project, Add Text Layer, and Theme toggle buttons. All using IconButton + Tooltip from ui-library. Theme toggle shows sun/moon icon. Typecheck passes.
